limitations: A storage-GRANTED durable round-trip across a SERVICE-WORKER restart is NOT exercised by the integration harness: the optional storage permission requires a headed owner gesture (chrome.permissions.request) that a headless profile cannot grant. The durable WRITE path itself is unit-tested (kvSet returns 'durable' when the backend is present + healthy, and throws StorageBackendError when the backend write fails — tests/kv.test.ts).

The sidebar's 'error' durability path is exercised at the UNIT level (kvSet rejects on a backend failure), not through a production fault route: the fault seam is deliberately ABSENT from the shipped bundle (build.mjs asserts kv.fault / __setKvFaultForTest / cap-kv-fault-test are not in the dist).
